hash_convention: canonical_json_sha256 = SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii false and no NaN; raw artifacts keep exact byte hashes in their receipts.
scope: Evidence/readiness ledger for the minimal four-stage canonical workflow. Noncanonical entries are retained for provenance only.

reconciled_source_links.remaining: Source link ledger is fixed; preserve it without turning source recovery into a new analysis.

native_authority_input_chain.remaining: Exact native cohort and saved authority joins are recovered. Historical HTTP byte identity is not required for further scientific expansion.

enriched_source_cohort.remaining: 319244 native observations are connected to dates, photo schedule and known dependence.

image_only_qualification.remaining: Existing measurement/QC route decision is frozen; do not reopen it from ecological results.

reconciled_stream_schedule.remaining: All native source observations and links are scheduled. Finish/reconcile the already-authorized measurement work; do not create new scientific routes.

durable_private_numerical_replay.remaining: Protected numerical recovery is verified. Future measurement outputs only need the same recovery discipline.

native_source_to_measurement_coverage.remaining: After the current measurement wave is reconciled, record only the minimal completion ledger: complete/pending/source-blocked observations plus endpoint/module missingness. Do not fit taxon-, region- or environment-specific assessability models.

primary_module_response_geometry.remaining: Use the already-frozen orientation=1, visible_colour=8 and gross_shape=4 representation on the reconciled measurement cohort. Keep all 27 raw endpoints; no outcome-driven reduction.

joint_covariance_aware_hierarchy.remaining: Run the existing partially pooled within/among implementation once the measurement cohorts are fixed.

calendar_imaging_nuisance_design.remaining: Use the already-frozen nuisance design on the realized cohorts; do not add or reselect nuisance terms.

fixed_full_test_family.remaining: Use the already-declared one-model, 36-slot family when the canonical ecology run is executed. No new testing family is added.

versioned_colour_definition.remaining: NONCANONICAL TECHNICAL WORK. The uniform-floral candidate does not block v3; canonical colour continues to use the registered legacy chroma.

model_specific_environment_diagnostics.remaining: NONCANONICAL SUPPORT. Routine rank/VIF diagnostics may accompany the ecology run if needed, but they are not a separate readiness stage or discovery analysis.

dependence_aware_inference_simulation.remaining: NONCANONICAL TECHNICAL AUDIT. Preserve completed/current calibration results as QA evidence; do not extend tail/repair/calibration branches or make them a canonical gate.
